components.name: RollingNumber
components.summary: A number whose digits roll like an odometer when it changes; the base for every count and total in the kit.

components.name: ProductCard
components.summary: The product tile for category grids, search results and "you may also like" rows.

components.name: WishlistHeart
components.summary: The save-to-wishlist toggle: a heart that pops and bursts when saved and quietly empties when unsaved.

components.name: VariantPicker
components.summary: Size or colour selection for one product, as a radio group with a single selected pill that glides between options.

components.name: QuantityStepper
components.summary: Minus / count / plus for the product page and cart lines; the count rolls and the limits push back.

components.name: AddToCartButton
components.summary: The add-to-bag button: plus → spinner while the add is in flight → drawn tick and "Added", or a shake and "Try again".

components.name: CollectionAccordion
components.summary: Category or collection panels in a row; the one under the pointer (or keyboard focus) opens wide and shows its title, line and link.

components.name: SkeletonCard
components.summary: A loading stand-in with the same shape as ProductCard, so the grid doesn't jump when products arrive.

components.name: FreeShippingMeter
components.summary: "Add ₹350 more for free delivery", with a bar that fills as the cart grows and a tick when it is unlocked.

components.name: ToastStack
components.summary: Notifications stacked into one card with the two behind peeking out; point at it or tab into it and it springs apart into a list.

components.name: ConfirmButton
components.summary: A two-step destructive button: the first press widens it into a question ("Remove item?") with a draining timer, the second confirms.

components.name: OtpInput
components.summary: One-time code boxes for phone sign-in and checkout: typing advances, Backspace steps back, paste and SMS autofill fill every box.

components.name: OrderTracker
components.summary: Live order status: a big ETA, one live line ("Ravi is 2.1 km away") and a rail that fills to the current step.

components.name: StackedBars
components.summary: Seller revenue by channel as stacked bars, with a Day / Week toggle; point at or focus a bar and the headline scrubs to that bar.
